title: Nyang Pasien
intro: Jameun that, bak masa awai seujarah manusia, dua boh jiwa jidong dikeue Pencipta awaknyan deungon keureubeuen. Saboh jiteurimong, saboh hana. Peuë njang teudjadi seulanjutdjih akan djeuët keu tragedi rajek njang phôn antara sjèëdara-sjèëdara - saboh buët peutheun sabar dan saboh buët balas dendam njang phet. Jeut neubuka soe lon?
clues: Lon lahe bak uroe-uroe phon that manusia na di ateuh bumoe .
Lon aneuk dari pasangan manusia phon yang pernah jak bak bumoe nyoe
Na lôn peuseumah keureubeuen nyang paleng jroh lam kawan bubiri lôn keu lôn peuseunang até Pencipta lôn .
Peuseumahan lôn geuteurimong nibak ateueh, seudangkan peuseumahan syedara lôn geutulak
Watee diancam mate, lon pileh untuk hana lon angkat jaroe lon keu syedara lon .
Lon jeut keu ureung phon lam mandum seujarah manusia nyang salah dipoh le ureung laen .

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
